components.name: AI Input Selector
components.description: AI chat input with a model menu, a separate Effort control, file chips you can drop or paste, a / command menu, and Stop while replying.

components.name: Command Button
components.description: A button with its shortcut drawn as keycaps that sink as you press the real keys.

components.name: Flick Card
components.description: A two-sided card you spin with a drag or a flick, with thickness, light and a floor shadow that follow the angle.

components.name: Smooth Drawer
components.description: Checkout bottom sheet on Vaul snap points, peeking at the total and dragging up for details.

components.name: Halftone Background
components.description: Any image, or a lit sphere, printed as a halftone dot screen, with a loupe that looks closer under the cursor, built with React and canvas.

components.name: Shape Hero
components.description: A landing hero where shapes drop in, pile up under the headline and can be grabbed and thrown.

components.name: AI Text Loading
components.description: AI thinking text with a soft wave through the letters and words that swap letter by letter.

components.name: Momentum Rail
components.description: A card rail you flick with momentum, snapping on a spring, with scroll-driven cover-flow depth and parallax.

components.name: File Upload
components.description: A multi-file upload queue with per-file progress, retry and cancel.

components.name: Command Palette
components.description: ⌘K command palette with nested pages, fuzzy matching and in-row progress for running actions.

components.name: AI Input Search
components.description: AI search input with Quick and Research modes and a live trace underneath that stacks each source as it is read, times the run and opens into the full source list. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

components.name: Cradle Text
components.description: A headline hung like a Newton's cradle, so a knock on one letter clacks through the word, built with React and pendulum physics.

components.name: Currency Transfer
components.description: Transfer tracker that converts the amount in place, walks through each step on a filling rail, and ends with a copyable reference. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

components.name: Background Paths
components.description: A ribbon of lines in one color that keeps flowing at any size and parts around the cursor.

components.name: Dot Field
components.description: A halftone dot membrane that ripples behind a swipe and rings out from a click, built with React and Canvas.

components.name: Wind
components.description: Streamlines that part around the cursor, swirl in its wake and scatter on click, built with React and Canvas.

components.name: Topo Background
components.description: A living contour map that drifts, rises under the cursor and ripples on click, built with React and Canvas.

components.name: Drape Background
components.description: A pleated curtain in a breeze that you can push and pull, built with React, WebGL and a cloth simulation.

components.name: Apple Activity Card
components.description: Activity rings that draw with a count-up, lap past 100% with a shadowed end cap and dim to focus, built with React and Motion.

components.name: AI Voice
components.description: Voice input with a scrolling waveform, then a take you can play back, discard or send.

components.name: Swipe Tabs
components.description: Tabs with a swipeable panel, a drag-tracked indicator and spring physics.

components.name: Marking Menu
components.description: A radial menu you hold to open or flick to pick blind, built with React and Motion.

components.name: Team Selector
components.description: Seat picker with a scrubbable number, generated avatars and an optional rolling price line.

components.name: Detent Dial
components.description: Rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch and coasts when flicked, built with React and Motion.

components.name: Liquid Slider
components.description: A vertical slider you fill like a glass, with a sloshing surface and rising bubbles.

components.name: Signature Pad
components.description: A signature field with a sprung pen tip, speed-weighted ink and SVG output.

components.name: Switch Button
components.description: Light and dark theme toggle whose sun folds into a moon while the new theme spreads from the button as a circle.

components.name: Pull Cord
components.description: A lamp switch you pull on a swinging cord, built with React and a rope simulation.

components.name: Tear Button
components.description: A confirm button you tear off like a ticket stub, hole by hole.

components.name: Bell Button
components.description: A subscribe button whose bell swings and rings, with a clapper that really strikes.

components.name: Widget Grid
components.description: Dashboard widgets you lift, drag and resize on a 6-column grid, with spring physics and full keyboard support.

components.name: Hold Button
components.description: Press and hold to confirm, with a fill that drains back on early release and a drawn check on completion.

components.name: Magnet Button
components.description: A call-to-action button wrapped in a field of iron filings that align to its magnetic field and lean toward your cursor.

components.name: Gradient Button
components.description: Layered gradient button with emerald, purple, and orange variants, a gradient border in light and dark mode, soft inner glow, press feedback, and an optional icon, styled entirely with Tailwind CSS in React.

components.name: V0 Button
components.description: Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS.

components.name: Tool Dock
components.description: An editor tool dock with a sliding selection plate, shortcut tooltips and flyouts that you can throw to any edge.

components.name: AI State Loading
components.description: Agent progress as a list of steps with a live log, elapsed time and a summary when done.

components.name: AI Tool Approval
components.description: Approve or deny an agent's tool calls. Destructive calls need a press and hold, and decided calls fold into a trace with their output.

components.name: AI Context Meter
components.description: How full the context window is, as a ring in the prompt footer that opens a breakdown by source and compacts when it fills.

components.name: AI Inline Citations
components.description: An answer with source chips beside each claim. One preview glides between chips and lights up the sentence it backs.

components.name: AI Diff Review
components.description: A coding agent's edits streaming in file by file, then reviewed per file with accept, reject and undo.

components.name: AI Model Selector
components.description: Pick a model and how hard it thinks. Effort is a detent track that reshapes for each model and keeps your level when you switch.

components.name: Throw Deck
components.description: A pile of image cards you drag, flick off the top and send under the deck, with arrow keys and a details view.

components.name: Notification Stack
components.description: Stacked notifications that fan out on hover and swipe away, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

components.name: Liquid Gauge
components.description: A usage meter filled with liquid that sloshes, ripples and bubbles, built with React and a wave simulation.

components.name: Activity Terrain
components.description: A contribution heatmap that tilts up into a 3D terrain you can turn, built with React and canvas.

components.name: Receipt Printer
components.description: A receipt that prints line by line, then tears off and falls when you pull it, built with React.

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: A revenue KPI card. Scrub a day, drag a range, or pick a segment; the number rolls, the line morphs and the breakdown follows.

components.name: Uptime Card
components.description: A status page card with 90 days per service that swell under the cursor, and a day you click opens its incident log.

components.name: Spending Ring
components.description: A spending breakdown you spin like a dial; flick the ring and it settles with a category under the marker.

components.name: Focal Point Picker
components.description: Set where a photo's subject is and see every crop follow it live. Hover a crop to see what it cuts.

components.name: Photo Straighten
components.description: Level a crooked photo on a ruler you drag or flick. The crop grows to hide the corners, and a grid shows while you adjust.

components.name: Clip Trimmer
components.description: A video trim timeline with a filmstrip, handles that snap to whole seconds and a playhead that loops the kept range.

components.name: Synced Transcript
components.description: A transcript that follows the spoken word, lets you click any word to jump there, and waits when you scroll away.

components.name: Avatar Picker
components.description: Generated avatars from a name, morphing as you type, on a 3D coin you can flick, tap or shuffle.

components.name: Wheel Picker
components.description: iOS-style 3D drum picker with flick momentum, built with React and Motion.

components.name: Typing Text
components.description: Typewriter text that makes the odd typo and corrects it, erases by selecting, and blinks its caret only when idle, built with React and Motion.

components.name: Extruded Text
components.description: Zinc 3D extruded text lit by your pointer, with letters that press in like keycaps.

components.name: Scroll Index
components.description: A section rail for long pages, with a tick per heading that you can hover, click or drag to scrub, built with React.

components.name: Plucked Text
components.description: A headline sitting on a string you can pluck, strum and let ring, built with React and real string physics.

components.name: Glitch Text
components.description: Flat text that cuts into hard-shifted bands with a thin red/cyan split, on idle, hover or text change.

components.name: Dynamic Text
components.description: Morphing text where shared letters travel, old ones fall and new ones land, with decode and cycle modes.

components.name: Particle Button
components.description: A status button for async actions, with a spinner, a drawn check and a particle burst on success.

components.name: Now Playing
components.description: Music card with a spinning disc you can grab and turn to scrub, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

components.name: Account Menu
components.description: An account card that morphs into its own menu, with account switching, status, theme and hold-to-sign-out.

components.name: Loader
components.description: Animated loading indicator with rotating gradient rings, size variants and customizable title text. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

components.name: Slide Text Button
components.description: Animated link button with a vertical text slide on hover and default and ghost variants, built with React, Next.js Link, and Tailwind CSS.

components.name: Split Nav
components.description: Navigation bar that splits around the active link, with drag-to-scrub, flick projection and an optional compact fold.

components.name: Status Island
components.description: A pill that reports background work, reshaping as tasks change and opening into a list of everything in flight.

components.name: Morph Popover
components.description: A button that grows into the form it opens, with its label sliding up to become the title, then shrinks into a confirmation.

components.name: Lightbox Grid
components.description: A photo grid whose thumbnails grow into a full view and fly back to their slot when you drag them down.

components.name: Spoiler Text
components.description: Inline text hidden under drifting specks, like a chat spoiler. A click blows the specks away from the point you touched.

components.name: Stack Panel
components.description: A panel that drills into pages like settings on a phone. The tapped row's label flies up into the title, and a swipe right takes you back.

components.name: AI Autocomplete
components.description: A text box that suggests how your sentence ends in grey after the caret. Tab takes it all, the right arrow takes one word, and typing the same letters keeps it.

components.name: Undo Button
components.description: An action button that gives you a few seconds to take it back, with the time left drawn around its own edge.

components.name: Use Auto Resize Textarea
components.description: React hook that auto-resizes a textarea to fit its content between a min and max height.

components.name: Use Click Outside
components.description: React hook that runs a callback when the user clicks outside the referenced element.

components.name: Use Copy To Clipboard
components.description: React hook that copies text to the clipboard and exposes a copied state with a reset timeout.

components.name: Use Mobile
components.description: React hook that reports whether the viewport is below the 768px mobile breakpoint.

components.name: Utils
components.description: The cn utility for merging Tailwind CSS classes, built on clsx and tailwind-merge.
